text: Claude Pro users: Fable 5.2 costs nothing extra until Monday night. Then it eats paid credits.
So don't burn the week on emails. Build these three.
One: your 3D twin. Answer five questions, and Fable codes a 3D animal that's built like you.
Two: your 2027. It asks the questions nobody asks you, then turns the answers into a plan, month by month.
Three, the one that lasts: have Fable write its own playbook as a Skill, so cheaper models keep working like it after Monday.
Comment FABLE and I'll send you all three prompts.
